header.name: Chocolate_PR1
header.full_name: Milk chocolate from whole cocoa beans (route PR1)
header.description: Milk chocolate production from whole fermented cocoa beans: debacterization, roasting, winnowing, grinding, pressing, mixing and refining, conching, tempering, moulding and cooling, with 45 thermal streams from the Swiss chocolate sector.

variables.full_name: Chocolate production
variables.description: Milk chocolate produced. Every flow and heat load is given per 1 t/h and scales with it; the category 1 reference plant, 1,000 t/y over 3,600 h/y, is 0.278 t/h

units.unit_description: This unit converts whole fermented cocoa beans into 1 t/h of milk chocolate (route PR1): debacterization, whole-bean roasting with hot air, cooling and winnowing, grinding of the nibs into cocoa liquor, pressing of part of the liquor into cocoa butter and press cake, mixing and refining, conching, tempering, moulding and cooling. It includes the warm-water tracing network and the cleaning in place of the site.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes cocoa beans, sugar, whole milk powder, lecithin, purchased cocoa butter and electricity, and delivers milk chocolate, press cake, cocoa shells and the water vapour of the roaster exhaust. The flows close at 1,094.3 kg/h in and out.

units.heat_streams_description: 34 cold and 11 hot streams from the Swiss chocolate sector data, time-averaged over the operating hours; batch steps (conching, CIP) are given by their average load. Streams with a span of 0.1 or 1 K are near-isothermal duties. The production cooling H11 is the chilled-water demand at 11 to 5 °C.
